keywords: EIP-8411 快速执行载荷广播
summary: 周六较平静。benjaminion 展示了解耦共识的概念验证，在相当于主网一定比例规模的网络上把最终确认时间缩短约 4 倍。kamilsa 提交新 EIP，把执行载荷改为分块传播。ladislaus0x 发起的众包活动一天内得到经过优化且形式化验证的 MODEXP EVM 实现。

items.topic: 更快的最终性和更快的出块
items.title: benjaminion：快速最终性要来了
items.note: 15:31，一个快速概念验证，在相当于主网一定比例规模的网络上把最终确认时间提升约 4 倍，主要目的是给解耦共识做基准测试。
items.note_en: 15:31, a quick proof of concept on a network a decent fraction of mainnet's size that improved time to finality about 4x, mainly to benchmark decoupled consensus.

items.topic: 更快的最终性和更快的出块
items.title: barnabemonnot：看到“解耦共识”，就想想更快的最终性和更快的出块
items.title_en: barnabemonnot: when you read "decoupled consensus", think faster finality and faster blocks
items.note_en: 15:55, with networking setting the speed limit.

items.topic: 更快的最终性和更快的出块
items.title: 新 EIP：快速执行载荷广播
items.note: （kamilsa，10 月 1 日合并），用分块传播替代原 `execution_payload` 主题，后编号为 EIP-8411。
items.title_en: New EIP: fast execution payload broadcast
items.note_en: (kamilsa, merged October 1), replacing the `execution_payload` topic with chunked propagation; it later became EIP-8411.

items.title: ladislaus0x：一天之内，28 份提交得出竞争性优化且形式化验证的 MODEXP EVM 实现
items.title_en: ladislaus0x: one day later, 28 submissions produced a competitively optimized and formally verified EVM implementation of MODEXP

items.note: 05:30，比如区块级 PQ 签名聚合中的电路与 VM、递归选择。
items.title_en: tcoratger: Bitcoin and Ethereum post-quantum discussions are converging on similar questions
items.note_en: 05:30, such as circuits versus VMs and recursion for block-wide PQ signature aggregation.

items.title_en: ameensol spoke in Amsterdam on the Tornado Cash case and compliant privacy

summary_en: A quiet Saturday. benjaminion showed a proof of concept of decoupled consensus that cut time to finality by about 4x on a network a decent fraction of mainnet's size. kamilsa submitted a new EIP that propagates execution payloads in chunks. A crowdsourcing effort started by ladislaus0x produced an optimized and formally verified EVM implementation of MODEXP within a day.
